summary: First test run of Plan & Tour app. Backend API validation passes, hero section UI looks great, input validations work. Critical issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has a max budget of $0.001 but claude-4-sonnet-20250514 costs ~$0.029 per call - budget is exceeded after just ONE call.

critical.issue: LLM budget exceeded after 1 call. Max budget: $0.001, but claude-4-sonnet-20250514 costs ~$0.029835 per call. API returns 500 with: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded!'

integration_issues.issue: Tour generation fails with 500 after LLM budget exceeded (root cause is backend LLM key budget). Error message is correctly shown to the user in the form.

action_items: CRITICAL: Increase budget limit on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - current max is $0.001 but claude-4-sonnet-20250514 costs ~$0.03 per call. The key is exhausted after a single request.
Consider switching to a cheaper model (claude-3-haiku) if budget is a constraint, or reset/replace the API key with sufficient budget
critical_code_review_comments: LLM key budget $0.001 is too low for claude-4-sonnet-20250514 (~$0.03/call). App becomes non-functional after one use.
Backend code is well-structured - JSON parsing, MongoDB persistence, error handling all look correct.
Missing data-testid on loading state component - unable to verify loading animation visibility during test.

success_rate.backend: 57% (4/7 tests pass - validation tests pass, generation works once but budget exceeded)
success_rate.frontend: 40% - UI loads correctly, validations work, but tour generation fails due to LLM budget

context_for_next_testing_agent: The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exhausted ($0.001 max, ~$0.03 per call). Once the key is reset/replaced, all other functionality appears to work correctly: hero section looks good, input validation works (tests pass), form submits correctly, error display works. Backend code structure is clean. Need to test the full flow (tour results tabs, premium/budget cards, reset button) after key budget is fixed.

rca_of_issue.reproduction: Call /api/tour/generate once - it works. Second call fails with 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.029835, Max budget: 0.001'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env has a per-key budget of $0.001 which is less than the cost of a single claude-4-sonnet-20250514 API call (~$0.03)
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Reset or replace EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with one that has a higher budget limit, or switch to a cheaper model
